class.description: Unconditional early-trajectory heading critic - commits to the path's near-term curvature from the very first control cycle, without the gating conditions nav2's own PathAngleCritic/ConstraintCritic apply. See CHANGELOG.md 2026-07-18 (9).

Once the robot deviates from the path beyond deviation_threshold, pulls trajectories toward a point further along the path instead of insisting on an exact rejoin. Inactive (zero cost) while on-track. See CHANGELOG.md 2026-08-26.
